Phase 63 impl @ c35e793 (branch phase/roadmap-placeholders-are-not-phases). gate: see entry @ c35e793 — I did not run the full suite.

What changed
- tagteam/roadmap.py: _is_placeholder() (^\[[^\]]*\]$ on the stripped title); parse_roadmap() skips placeholders but still splits sections on every strict heading, and raises the same ValueError when no real phase remains (message names the placeholder count); validate_identities() skips them; new placeholder_phase_headings() and has_real_phase(); roadmap check implements the approved round-3 algorithm verbatim: warnings, then if not has_real_phase: identity problems -> invalid/exit 1, else placeholders -> 'ok: 0 phase(s)'/exit 0, else fall through to the unchanged graph_problems() path. No except yields success.
- tagteam/framework.py: SEED_FILES -> seeds/roadmap.md, seeds/decision_log.md; tagteam/data/seeds/ added (decision_log byte-identical; roadmap's Getting Started rewritten, [Name] headings kept); pyproject glob data/seeds/*.md. data/templates and data/history untouched.
- tests/_provenance.py (new, shared): the frozen and history path sets + tag helpers. test_framework's Phase 62 table test now iterates prov.history_paths(); new test_retired_path_sources_are_frozen_at_the_tag pins data/templates + data/checklists to v3.14.1 (file list and bytes) and asserts the set equals _retired_sources().
- tests/test_plugin.py: test_no_older_command_family_outside_pinned_provenance — hits must equal exactly the two allowlisted paths, the allowlist must be a subset of prov.pinned_relpaths(), and the same scan flags a stray temp .md; test_handoff_family_audit_still_scans_the_exempt_files. The /handoff-* audit is unchanged.
- Docs: CLAUDE.md, tagteam/data/workflows.md (+ this repo's docs/workflows.md refreshed by setup, manifest re-stamped).

Criteria -> tests (tests/test_roadmap.py::TestPlaceholderPhases unless noted): 1 test_fresh_setup_passes_check; 2 test_seeded_roadmap_is_valid_with_warnings[pre-63-seed]; 3 …bounds_sections_and_is_no_phase; 4 test_only_a_whole_bracketed_title… + test_real_titles_with_brackets…; 5 …unknown_dependency; 6 …claim_no_number_and_no_slug; 7 test_identity_problems_are_never_masked… (your two fixtures: exit 1, 'Phase 2: empty name', duplicate number, no 'roadmap ok'); 8 …same_error_as_before + …say_why_there_is_nothing; 9 test_callers_see_the_seed_exactly_as… (launch._actionable_phases, launch._next_after, graph_problems/parse_roadmap raising ValueError as the watcher and worktree expect); 10-12 the framework/plugin tests above; 11 also: a scratch wheel contains data/seeds/roadmap.md and decision_log.md.

Criterion 13, real registry, read-only: the 9 projects with the unedited seed go from 'roadmap invalid' to 'roadmap ok: 0 phase(s) — 3 placeholder heading(s) to rename' with no edit. Across all 41, one roadmap remains invalid: northstar-test-automation (duplicate phase numbers 7 and 8 — real, out of scope). Table in the phase doc.

Verified by me: focused only — test_roadmap.py 114, test_framework.py + test_plugin.py + test_setup.py + test_roadmap.py together 280 passed; the v3.14.1 freeze test ran, not skipped.

GATE: PASS | scope 14 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (2074 passed, 5 skipped, 7m41s)
checked: HEAD c35e793

Approved implementation at c35e793. Reviewed parser/check control flow, seed separation and packaging, regression tests, shared provenance pinning, audit allowlist, and documentation/registry results. Placeholder headings are excluded from phases and identities while remaining strict section boundaries. The no-real-phase branch reports identity problems before allowing placeholder success; ordinary graph aggregation remains unchanged. Both plan-review regressions are covered. Existing project roadmaps are not rewritten, frozen templates/history remain unchanged, and the older-command exemption is limited to the two tag-pinned files without weakening the handoff-family audit.

Verification: accepted GATE_PASS at HEAD c35e793 (2074 passed, 5 skipped). Reviewer focused run of TestPlaceholderPhases, frozen-source/seed tests, and TestShippedDocsAudit: 18 passed, no skips. git diff --check is clean. Full suite not rerun. No blocking findings.
